decision.summary: The CP12 is valid until 16 Oct 2026 but the tenant has not answered three contact attempts. I opened JOB-101, assigned HeatRight for 13 Oct 9-1, gave the tenant written notice on all channels with a way to rearrange, told the landlord, and set a follow-up for 12 Oct.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant? Which record do you trust?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, Gas Safe 550123, matching HeatRight) over the vague legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025, all good', which has no dates. It lapses after 16 Oct if no new check is done.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Booked HeatRight (the gas contractor on file) for 13 Oct 9-1, more than 24h away and before expiry. Gave written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange. No forced entry; holding keys gives no right of entry. Follow-up set for 12 Oct to retry and rebook if needed.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Told Ben the expiry date, that the tenant hasn't responded, the booked date and the notice steps, that we won't enter without agreement, and that we'll update him by 12 Oct.

conflicts: Legacy note says cert renewed 2025 'all good' without dates; compliance record gives the expiry of 16 Oct 2026. Trusted the compliance record.
